sources.text: 14.3 Opioid Agonists and Antagonists Learning Outcomes By the end of this section, you should be able to: 14.3.1 Identify the characteristics of opioid agonist and antagonist drugs used to treat pain. 14.3.2 Explain the indications, actions, adverse reactions, and contraindications of opioid agonist and antagonist drugs used to treat pain. 14.3.3 Describe nursing implications of opioid agonist and antagonist drugs used to treat pain. 14.3.4 Explain the client education related to opioid agonist and antagonist drugs used to treat pain. Opioid Agonists Opioid agonist s have been in use for thousands of years.
